tasks.short: Interpret a landscaping design on site

steps.what: Find the current planned landscaping design and planting legend
Read the landscaping design to determine the intended sod, grass and planting areas
Compare the planned landscaping design with the ground and locate actual planting positions

tasks.design: Link the released site drawing and its legend directly to the work assignment in {DOCS}. The worker still interprets the design and checks actual ground conditions using existing measuring and marking tools {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Similar site drawings and separate planting legends create avoidable document searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job folders and revision links can remove that navigation without producing a new design.
tasks.still_hard: Site levels, existing vegetation and obstructions may differ from the drawing.
tasks.human_edge: Relate drawn positions to actual ground and recognize when the designer must resolve a conflict.

ambition.what: The worker keeps the same responsibility for following the design.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked site drawings can shorten retrieval, but interpreting a planting design against real ground conditions remains hands-on judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is following an existing design to locate planting areas, not designing the landscape, planting or issuing a revised drawing. No routine interpretation report is invented.

The landscape designer produces drawing id, site id, revision, dimensions and planting legend. The work planner associates the site assignment. The worker reads original drawing information and measures actual locations; no clean geospatial model or new survey capture is assumed.

Three of fifteen retrieval units are repeated folder and legend navigation; twelve remain for obtaining and matching the actual drawing. Existing document runtime earns no saving. Native links are tested before any custom code.

There is no author save, send or commit in this reading and physical-location task. If a site conflict requires formal communication, its real message and authority must be mapped for that case. Shares are illustrative, not measured.
unknowns: Whether the current assignment already links the released drawing
How often drawings have missing dimensions or an incompatible site reference
research_questions: Does the direct link show both the current drawing revision and the correct legend?

already_counted.description: Obtain the design, interpret planting requirements and locate positions on the real site

incremental.description: Repair stale drawing and legend links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97 gross3 less upkeep1 gives2. For a legacy drawing with a separate paper legend, retrieval retains14 of15 while interpretation35 and site matching50 remain. Gross1 less upkeep1 gives0; no physical work is accelerated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The worker spends slightly less time finding drawings while keeping site interpretation and physical layout duties.
role.ambitious_version: Use the small retrieval gain to check the ground against the intended design carefully.
